name: bluebridge-sites
description: Plan digital marketing and review websites through your existing agent, using authenticated Blue Bridge Sites access. Current execution capabilities are read-only.

defaultPrompt: Help me prioritize my marketing content
interface.longDescription: Use your existing agent to discuss marketing strategy, prioritize content, plan website work and review available performance evidence. Authenticated Sites tools currently read your authorized organizations, websites and draft status. Saving strategy/backlogs, retrieving measurements, source preparation and draft submission remain non-persisting mocks; social publishing is not implemented.
